items.title: Cosy Boho Bedroom with a DIY Gallery Wall for Autumn
items.description: A warm boho bedroom with a DIY gallery wall, trailing plants, rattan lighting and autumn-toned cushions. Easy seasonal updates on a budget.

image.alt: Boho bedroom with a gallery wall of prints, trailing plants, a rattan pendant light, grey bedding and an orange cushion

items.title: Boutique Hotel Luxury Bedroom with a Channel-Tufted Bed
items.description: Bring boutique-hotel luxury home with a channel-tufted upholstered bed, a dark feature wall, brass lighting and soft layered textures.

image.alt: Luxury bedroom with a grey channel-tufted upholstered bed, dark accent wall, brass chandelier, bedside lamps and two fluffy stools

items.title: Compact Bedroom with Smart Bedside Storage
items.description: Make a small bedroom work harder with a drawer bedside table, a slim lamp and layered textiles. Budget-friendly storage ideas for compact rooms.

image.alt: Small bedroom with a grey bed, navy and white patterned cushions, a white bedside table with a drawer and a black table lamp

items.title: Japandi Calm Bedroom with a Low Wooden Platform Bed
items.description: A serene Japandi bedroom built around a low wooden platform bed, soft white linen and warm neutrals. Simple, calm and easy to keep tidy.

image.alt: Minimalist bedroom with a low wooden platform bed, white bedding, beige cushions and a plain cream wall
